head: ShiftBoard puts firefighter and EMT shift rotations on one calendar
dek: ShiftBoard shows every shift rotation you work or track on one calendar, with ready-made rotations like 24/48 and 48/96, for firefighters, paramedics, EMTs and 911 dispatchers. It was #30 among paid Productivity apps on the US App Store on 7 November.
details: It came out on 6 November and costs $0.99, by Chisholm Digital.
means: If your family works rotating shifts, you can see everyone's schedule in one place.
todo: Find ShiftBoard in the App Store.
